crossRefs.note: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.
laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

translations.web: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
translations.bsb: it prepares its provisions in summer; it gathers its food at harvest.
translations.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
translations.asv: Provideth her bread in the summer, And gathereth her food in the harvest.
